Bjorth - Drums of Midgard (Viking music and medieval music)

runs.text: Bjorth is strongly themed by Norse and central European folklore and mythology but does not stick to all traditional sounds and instruments. Vocals, which are based mostly on old Norse mythology are performed by Chilean singer/songwriter Daniela (Dani)  Alvear, who joined Bjorth early after the first releases.
